batch_07.why: Only 11 never-researched candidates score above the P4 floor. 222 of the remaining 371 P4 records have no description, no website and no product on file, so they cannot be researched until the basics exist. Batch 07 therefore carries every remaining real lead as VERIFY plus a first 29-row ENRICH pass over the no-data mass.
